raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Delivery batch 13 (ingest 2026-01-18) sent merchant_id as 'M-0NNN' strings instead of plain integers, so the INTEGER cast in silver_transactions fails. The profile shows 80 distinct values, exactly the 40 numeric IDs (100-139) plus 40 prefixed forms up to 'M-0139'. This indicates a pure formatting change that maps directly to the existing merchant IDs.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.8, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CASE WHEN regexp_matches(merchant_id, '^M-[0-9]+$') THEN CAST(substr(merchant_id, 3) AS INTEGER) ELSE CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) END AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED';"}}
